title: SG-5.5.1 Remove duplicate SceneObject import and field in BootScene
description: Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts declares `import type { SceneObject }` twice (L12 and L14) and the `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = []` field twice (L22 and L23). Desired behavior: one import and one field remain. Expected result: no new type errors. Why: duplicate identifiers break compilation of the Phaser scene wrapper.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.ts, when it is read, then exactly one `import type { SceneObject }` line exists
Given BootScene.ts, when it is read, then exactly one `private sceneObjects` field exists
Given the frontend, when tsc --noEmit runs, then no duplicate identifier error is reported for BootScene.ts

in_scope: Delete duplicate import and field in BootScene.ts
